prompt.en: In Athens Paul found an altar with the inscription: TO THE ____.

prompt.en: ____ holds that explicit, conscious faith in Jesus Christ is necessary for salvation.

prompt.es: Hechos 4:12 dice que no hay otro ____ bajo el cielo, dado a los hombres, en que podamos ser salvos.

prompt.en: In Cuba, decades of official state ____ did not eliminate religion but drove much of it underground.
